claims.quote: For too long, people have put up with a railway that often lets them down.
claims.statement: The railway has for too long let people down.

claims.quote: This will bring investment and good jobs, giving young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.
claims.statement: The Derby headquarters will bring investment and good jobs and give young people a chance to build their future in Derby.

claims.quote: The biggest shake-up to our railways in a generation is underway.
claims.statement: The reform of the railways is the biggest shake-up in a generation.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring better services for passengers as its single mission.

claims.quote: creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The youth employment support package will create up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: We are determined to build the strong pipeline of skilled workers on which a thriving rail sector depends.
claims.statement: The government is determined to build a strong pipeline of skilled rail workers.

claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
claims.statement: The Derby headquarters announcement is fantastic news for Derby.

claims.quote: an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy

claims.quote: The new HQ will bring hundreds of rail jobs to the city

claims.quote: Derby is at the heart of a new era for British rail

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
